package rulefixtures

import (
	gorm "gorm.io/gorm"
)

// scenario for gorm_chain_built_in_handler: Handlers that construct `Where`, `Joins`, `Scopes`, or `Order` chains directly.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: warning.
type Rule057PositiveRecord struct {
	ID       int
	TenantID int
	Name     string
}

func scenario057Positive(db *gorm.DB, tenantID int) ([]Rule057PositiveRecord, error) {
	var items []Rule057PositiveRecord
	if err := db.Where("tenant_id = ?", tenantID).Joins("JOIN accounts ON accounts.id = rule_057_positive_records.account_id").Order("name ASC").Find(&items).Error; err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return items, nil
}
